name: A framed photograph
vera_note: Eight people at a long table, outdoor restaurant, afternoon light. Nobody is looking at the camera except one person on the far right, who is looking directly at whoever took the picture. Everyone else is mid-conversation. The table has the debris of a good meal — empty bottles, bread, glasses pushed aside to make room for elbows. The frame is the kind you buy at a pharmacy, not chosen for beauty. Someone cared about the photograph, not the frame. On the back: 'final paper done. we survived.' The year would have put this about nine years before the Quiet.
